Notes :
・Iris contains a retry mechanism for finding pools. There is the possibility where bad states were created. Whether through DEX internal testing, or a wrong Tx was picked up by Iris. This can happen, however Iris has the protections in place to not store these states. See AmmOperationHandler.ts line 142
・We are not adding tests calling live production endpoints, as a public accessible instance does not exist. Only internally hosted instances. So tests between Dexter & Iris are not possible, however we have added tests that work with the similar types between the two. This is suffice since the iris-sdk returns these exact same types.
・Test script commit (This was not pushed initially due to it containing a seed-phrase. This is now removed, so the test will fail unless you manually set one.) - https://github.com/3rd-Eye-Labs/dexter-v2/commit/272fbcff5db4ac3c99c3fd73dcece8d316a8979f
・The openapi.yaml API spec was corrected.
・Retested the Cardano Token Registry, and corrected one possible issue where the token could not be found. If you still see errors for this, please check you are using a valid Github Token.
